% imakeidx with a second index, printed before its entries, and a third
% sorted with xindy (tex8web sorts it with makeindex), after a minted
% listing, with hyperref: an entry of each named index, a subentry, and a
% "see" entry of the main index. Each number links to the place of its
% \index, right after the listing.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{minted,imakeidx}
\usepackage{hyperref}
\makeindex
\makeindex[name=names,title=Index of names]
\makeindex[name=terms,title=Index of terms,program=xindy]
\begin{document}
\printindex[names]
\section{Code}
\begin{minted}[linenos]{python}
total = total + 0
total = total + 1
total = total + 2
total = total + 3
total = total + 4
total = total + 5
total = total + 6
total = total + 7
total = total + 8
total = total + 9
total = total + 10
total = total + 11
total = total + 12
total = total + 13
total = total + 14
\end{minted}
After the listing, Knuth\index[names]{Knuth} wrote of the
code\index{code!listing}.\index{program|see{code}} A term\index[terms]{term}.
\printindex
\printindex[terms]
\end{document}
